profileCms.studio.wallet.title: Add art from wallets
profileCms.studio.wallet.scope: Find indexed works from The Memes, Meme Lab, 6529 Gradients and NextGen. This is a saved wallet snapshot, not a live feed of every NFT.
profileCms.studio.wallet.limits: Request up to 25 wallets or ENS names. A snapshot returns up to 200 indexed holdings; add up to 50 selected works at a time.
profileCms.studio.wallet.description: Works selected from a reviewed wallet snapshot.
profileCms.studio.wallet.added: Your selected works were added as a new gallery with artwork detail pages.
profileCms.studio.wallet.addFailed: The gallery could not be added. Review the current website and your selection, then try again.
profileCms.studio.wallet.ownerDisclosure: Selected works and their owner wallet addresses will be included in your published website. Other holdings and wallet inputs are left out.
profileCms.studio.wallet.tooManyWallets: Enter up to 25 wallets or ENS names.
profileCms.studio.wallet.truncated: This snapshot reached the result limit. Request fewer wallets to review more of their holdings.
profileCms.studio.wallet.partial: Some artwork previews are unavailable. You can still include their NFT detail pages.
profileCms.studio.wallet.unresolved: Some wallet inputs could not be resolved. Check the addresses or ENS names and request another snapshot.
profileCms.studio.wallet.fixture: Example snapshot: live wallet requests are disabled in this environment.
